description_en: Stops a specified live stream and changes the live stream status to ended
description_zh: 停止指定直播，直播状态改变为直播结束
kebab_example: aliyun imp stop-live --app-id 7m000q --room-id AE35-0000-T95F --user-id as0000hs --live-id b7f20000ebb3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopLive

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the application. The value can contain lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 应用唯一标识，可以包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The room ID. The value can contain letters and digits and is up to 36 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 房间ID，支持英文和数字，最大长度36个字符
parameters.name: room_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the live stream creator. The value must be unique within the AppId. The value can contain lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.) and is up to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 创建直播的UserId，在AppId下单独唯一。小写英文、数字、下划线（_）和小数点（.）组成，最大长度32个字符
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the live stream resource
parameters.name: live_id
